audience: hotel revenue and reservation teams who manage rooms, rates and bookings in Quendoo

useCases.title: Check which rooms are open for a date range
useCases.text: List the properties your token reaches, then read the availability per day and room type: rooms open, booked and to sell. Use a range of a few weeks.

useCases.title: Review bookings and their payment status
useCases.text: List the bookings of a property by check-in window, status or guest name. Open one booking to read its payment status and total amount.

useCases.title: Quote a cancellation before it is confirmed
useCases.text: Open the booking, then read the cost of cancelling it today under its cancellation policy. The quote changes nothing.

useCases.title: Compare rate plans and prices for a room type
useCases.text: List the rate plans of a property with their meal and cancellation policies. Read the prices and restrictions of one plan over a date range.

useCases.title: Close a room type or set a minimum stay
useCases.text: Open or close room types and set the rooms to sell for date ranges. Set stay limits, such as a minimum of two nights. Changes are stored only after the hotel sets the property to live.

useCases.title: Book a stay from a search
useCases.text: Search the offers for dates and a party, then book the chosen offer before its 30-minute search token expires. The booking returns a payment link. Bookings are stored only after the hotel sets the property to live.
